problem: Production could serve a stale i18n runtime from an unversioned asset URL after the canonical language control changed.
root_cause: The shared injector accepted any existing /assets/js/i18n.js and /assets/i18n.css reference without rotating the URL, so browser/CDN caches could retain an obsolete language-control implementation.
prevention: Canonical public i18n JS and CSS asset URLs carry an explicit version.
The shared injector rewrites existing i18n asset references to the current canonical version.
Production readback must prove same-route NL→EN→NL after exact-main deployment.
